text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O puts on a brave face. As 
if trying to act as cheerfully as she did 
before any talk about reaching her peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Only the most talked-about Umamusume have 
gathered for the Takarazuka Kinen. From 
Inari One riding high from the regional 
circuits, to the surging Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among them was Yaeno Muteki, with whom she 
had clashed during the Classics.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Facing them, Sakura Chiyono O muttered 
under her breath, "It's okay... I'll be 
okay..."
